{{velocity}}
#set ($licensor = $services.licensing.licensor.licensor)
#if ("$!request.user" != '')
  #set ($isUserUnderLimit = $licensor.isUserUnderLimit($services.model.resolveDocument($request.user),
    $numbertool.toNumber($request.limit).longValue()))
#end
{{html}}
Is user under limit:
<span id="isUserUnderLimit">$!isUserUnderLimit</span>
<br/>
User count on instance:
<span id="userCount">$licensor.userCount</span>
{{/html}}
{{/velocity}}
